cases.prompt: critique this icon svg
review my app icon - does it hold up at 16px?
render the icon candidates and tell me which is best
check the icons in icon-design/candidates at favicon size
my icon looks muddy when its small, can you fix it
does this logo mark still read as a bell at 32px?
compare the three icon candidates and pick the strongest
the glyph feels off center in the icon - review and adjust it
run a small-size legibility pass on icon.svg
rate my icon against the design rubric
design an app icon for my project
icon ideas for a music app
export favicons from the approved icon
review this pull request
critique my landing page design
review our toolbar icon set for visual consistency
why does my png look blurry in the readme?
review my svg chart rendering code
convert this random svg file to png for me
make the icon bigger in the navbar component
review the candidates in icon-design/candidates/ and improve the winner
expected_behavior: renders every candidate with scripts/render_icon.py at 512 plus the 64/32/16 strip before judging anything
reads the rendered PNGs and scores each candidate against the fixed rubric (16px silhouette, one Gestalt device, stroke consistency, optical centering, distinctiveness, contrast)
applies targeted SVG element edits as non-destructive revision files (-r1.svg) rather than regenerating or overwriting originals
re-renders after edits and stops within the 3-iteration cap
presents a ranked verdict with per-candidate one-line reasons and asks the human to approve before any export

cases.prompt: my icon is unreadable at 16px, fix it
expected_behavior: renders the icon at 16/32/64 first and states what actually vanishes, based on the render not the source code
applies the smallest targeted fix (thicken stroke, enlarge counter, drop the dying detail) and re-renders to confirm
runs check_svg.py-compatible constraints (does not introduce banned SVG features while fixing)
stops after the iteration cap even if imperfect, reporting remaining issues

cases.prompt: critique icon.svg on this machine with no svg tools installed
expected_behavior: runs the render script, which reports every renderer it tried and per-tool install hints
on macOS falls back to the built-in qlmanage renderer automatically
if no renderer exists, stops with the install instructions instead of critiquing unrendered SVG source

cases.prompt: make my icon prettier
expected_behavior: translates the vague request into specific rubric findings (what fails at which size, which device is muddy) instead of freeform aesthetic edits
states the limits of automated aesthetic judgment and keeps the human as the final judge of taste
any edit is justified by a named rubric axis
